data.name: CreatePurchaseOrderDescription
data.value: Creates a purchase order. Customer and vendor must have 4 to 50 characters, customer and PO number must be unique together, and fabricId (1 to 8) defaults to Algodon when omitted.

data.name: CreatePurchaseOrderBadRequest
data.value: The request body is not valid.

data.name: CreatePurchaseOrderSchema
data.value: Request data to create a purchase order.

data.name: PurchaseOrderSchema
data.value: A purchase order returned by the API.

data.name: PurchaseOrderCustomer
data.value: The customer that issued the purchase order (4 to 50 characters).

data.name: PurchaseOrderPoNumber
data.value: The PO number handled internally by the customer.

data.name: PurchaseOrderFabricId
data.value: The fabric identifier: 1 Algodon, 2 Modal, 3 Elastano, 4 Poliester, 5 Nailon, 6 Acrilico, 7 Rayon, 8 Lyocell.

data.name: PurchaseOrderVendor
data.value: The vendor of the purchase order (4 to 50 characters).
